The task ranges contain respectively nine T01 package files, seven T02 product/reference-boundary files, and seven T03 recovery-state files; no approved reference bytes changed.
The active CAP-01 campaign, eight immutable task evidence records, three DONE tasks, three independent approvals, and generated planning views validate exactly.

integratedBehavior: The standalone ui-tokens and ui-components packages expose versioned Academic Minimal contracts without source-path imports, undeclared runtime dependencies, literal-style drift, or generated-directory inventory gaps; direct runtime/type resolution and tree-shaking are verified.

Documented evidence, uncertainty, semantic boundary, panel, form, table, badge, dialog, notification, typography, and button identities use non-color text/symbol semantics and remain readable in light/dark themes from 100 through 200 percent scaling.

The functional desktop supplies complete landmarks, visible focus, skip navigation, a bounded shortcut registry, keyboard-only operation, modal focus containment and restoration, stable theme accessible naming/state, and live-region announcements.

Loading, empty, offline, denied, stale, partial, failed, and recovery-required states have typed identities and actionable retry, cancel, continue-locally, progress, retained-content, and diagnostic-copy contracts.

The current local-service seam truthfully reports that the sidecar is not yet packaged. Runtime adapter results remain unknown until exact allowlist decoding; malformed, credential-shaped, URL/path-bearing, extra-field, and hostile values fail closed to a nonblank generic state and fixed opaque diagnostic.

The development and production application contain exactly one functional CAP-01 page. The 32-page approved UI reference, illustrative records, future-capability routes, and nonfunctional actions remain isolated in design/conformance tooling and are never assembled into the product bundle.
